description: This file defines data structures, state management, and logic related to health monitoring of a service or device within the OpenClaw project. It includes models for health snapshots, the store for managing health state, and related utility functions, integrating with SwiftUI and other frameworks.

classes.name: HealthStore
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the health state of the application, performs periodic health checks, and provides status information.

methods.name: __setSnapshotForTest
methods.description: Test-only method to set the health snapshot and last error for testing purposes.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the periodic health check loop.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the periodic health check loop.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Performs an on-demand or scheduled refresh of the health snapshot.

methods.name: resolveLinkChannel
methods.description: Resolves the primary linked health channel from the snapshot.

methods.name: resolveFallbackChannel
methods.description: Finds a fallback healthy channel excluding a specified one.

methods.name: describeFailure
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the failure state.
